name: verify_order_owner
description: Verify order ownership and customer credentials against the order record.

name: get_order
description: Retrieve complete order details including status, dates, line items, pricing, discounts, and return history.

name: get_product
description: Retrieve product catalog details, category, list price, and returnability flags by SKU.

sku.description: The SKU of the product to look up.

name: get_return_policy
description: The return and exchange rules in effect for a product category (Footwear, Apparel, Accessories, Clearance): window, fee, final-sale rule, refund basis, and the policy library document and version they come from.

category.description: Product category to check policy for (e.g. Footwear, Apparel, Accessories, Clearance, or general).

source.description: The approved policy document in effect: file_id, title, version, effective_date

name: evaluate_return
description: Dry-run evaluation of return eligibility and calculated net refund amounts for specified order items.

items.description: List of items to evaluate for return.

name: create_return
description: Authorize a return for eligible order items, allocate refund estimation, and generate a synthetic return label. A repeated request_key returns the existing return instead of a second one.

customer_id.description: The customer identifier making the return.

request_key.description: Idempotency key for this return request, e.g. REQ-C01-O01-SH01

name: get_return_status
description: Check status of existing return authorizations, item details, and return shipping label by return_id or order_id.

order_id.description: Order identifier to find associated returns.

name: create_support_case
description: Create an escalated customer support case for exceptions, manual reviews, policy disputes, or service issues.

details.description: Detailed explanation of the issue or requested exception.

subject.description: Subject summary of the support issue.

name: search_orders
description: The orders of a customer identified by email and postal code (or by customer_id), newest first, with each line's quantity and what was already returned. Use it when the customer does not have their order number.

postal_code.description: The postal code on file, required with the email

name: get_customer_profile
description: The verified customer's profile: name, email, phone, postal code, address on file, store credit balance and order count. Verified by email or postal code.

postal_code.description: The postal code on file, to verify

name: get_shipment_tracking
description: Carrier, tracking number, status and last event of the verified customer's order shipment, with the shipping address on the order.

customer_id.description: The verified owner of the order

name: get_order_invoice
description: The invoice of the verified customer's order: lines with unit price, discount and net, totals and the PDF link.

customer_id.description: The verified owner of the order

name: cancel_order
description: Cancel the verified customer's order after they confirmed. Only an order still processing can be cancelled; once it has shipped it is returned after delivery instead. A repeated request_key returns the existing cancellation.

confirmed.description: True only after the customer confirmed the cancellation

name: update_shipping_address
description: Change the shipping address of the verified customer's order after they confirmed it. Only while the order is processing; a shipped order cannot be redirected. A repeated request_key returns the existing change.

new_address.description: The full new postal address, exactly as confirmed

confirmed.description: True only after the customer confirmed the address

name: create_exchange
description: Exchange a delivered item for another item of the same category, within the category's return window, after the customer confirmed. One exchange per order line; the price difference is issued as store credit or charged before the replacement ships. An exchange is not a refund. A repeated request_key returns the existing exchange.

replacement_sku.description: The SKU wanted instead, same category

confirmed.description: True only after the customer confirmed the exchange and any price difference

name: cancel_return
description: Cancel one of the verified customer's return authorizations that has not been received yet, after they confirmed; the label is voided and the units count as held again.

return_id.description: The return to cancel, e.g. R03

confirmed.description: True only after the customer confirmed

name: get_store_credit_balance
description: The verified customer's store credit balance and the credits it is made of, with their expiry dates. Verified by email or postal code.

postal_code.description: The postal code on file, to verify

name: search_threads
description: Lists email threads matching a Gmail search query (label:ID, is:unread, in:inbox, from:, to:, subject:, newer_than:7d, free terms). Full message bodies are not returned; use get_thread for them. Drafts, spam and trash are excluded.

name: get_thread
description: Retrieves an email thread by ID with its messages in date order (bodies under FULL_CONTENT).

threadId.description: The unique identifier of the thread.

messageFormat.description: MESSAGE_FORMAT_UNSPECIFIED, MINIMAL, FULL_CONTENT (default; bodies included) or METADATA_ONLY.

name: get_message
description: Retrieves one email message by its message ID.

messageId.description: The unique identifier of the message.

messageFormat.description: MESSAGE_FORMAT_UNSPECIFIED, MINIMAL, FULL_CONTENT (default; bodies included) or METADATA_ONLY.

name: list_labels
description: Lists the user-defined labels of the mailbox with their IDs. System label IDs (INBOX, UNREAD, STARRED, IMPORTANT, SENT, DRAFT, SPAM, TRASH) are usable without listing.

name: label_thread
description: Adds labels to an entire thread (every message in it). Takes label IDs, not names; use list_labels when unsure of a user label's ID.

threadId.description: The unique identifier of the thread.

labelIds.description: Label IDs (system IDs such as INBOX, UNREAD, IMPORTANT, or user label IDs from list_labels), never names.

name: unlabel_thread
description: Removes labels from an entire thread. Takes label IDs, not names.

threadId.description: The unique identifier of the thread.

labelIds.description: Label IDs (system IDs such as INBOX, UNREAD, IMPORTANT, or user label IDs from list_labels), never names.

name: list_drafts
description: Lists the mailbox's drafts, newest first. humanEdited marks a draft a person has edited.

name: create_draft
description: Creates a draft email for a person to review and send. To reply in an existing thread pass the original message's ID as replyToMessageId. Addresses are plain (no 'Name <email>'). Attachments are not supported yet. Nothing is sent.

replyToMessageId.description: The message this draft replies to; the draft joins its thread.

name: search_files
description: Search for Drive files using a structured query (syntax: `query_term operator values`). Clauses are joined with `and`; string values are single-quoted. Terms: title (contains, =, !=), fullText (contains), mimeType (contains, =, !=), parentId (=, !=), owner (=, !=; 'me' is the requesting user). Use nextPageToken to paginate.

pageToken.description: The page token to use for pagination.

pageSize.description: The maximum number of files to return in each page.

excludeContentSnippets.description: If true, the content snippet will be excluded from the response.

name: list_recent_files
description: Find recent files for the user in a sort order: recency (default), lastModified or lastModifiedByMe. The default page size is 10; use nextPageToken to paginate.

orderBy.description: The sort order for the files.

pageToken.description: The page token to use for pagination.

pageSize.description: The maximum number of files to return in each page.

excludeContentSnippets.description: If true, the content snippet will be excluded from the response.

name: get_file_metadata
description: General metadata about a Drive file. The description carries the policy family, status, version and effective date.

fileId.description: The ID of the file to retrieve.

excludeContentSnippets.description: If true, the content snippet will be excluded from the response.

name: get_file_permissions
description: List the permissions of a Drive file (its own and its folder's).

fileId.description: The ID of the file to get permissions for.

name: read_file_content
description: Fetch a natural language representation of a Drive file, and optionally its comments. fileId must come from search_files or list_recent_files. An unsupported format returns textFormattingNotSupported=true with empty fileContent. revisionId reads an earlier revision of the file.

fileId.description: The ID of the file to retrieve.

includeComments.description: Whether to include comments in the response.

revisionId.description: An earlier revision of the file to read instead of the current content.
